raw_meta_yaml:
# For dispatching between Unix and Windows
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "4.6.6"
  sha256: 1cd4c4c18263d2ae1f0cd5d4ba8b14e679b5a419ca15988a0da4cf43c514f28d

recipe:
  name: simdjson-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/simdjson/simdjson/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: ${{ sha256 }}

build:
  number: 1

outputs:
  - package:
      name: simdjson
    build:
      script: build
      files:
        - if: win
          then: Library/include/simdjson*
          else: include/simdjson*
        - if: linux
          then: lib/libsimdjson*.so*
        - if: osx
          then: lib/libsimdjson*.dylib*
        - if: win
          then: Library/bin/simdjson.dll
        - if: win
          then: Library/lib/simdjson.lib
        - if: win
          then: Library/lib/pkgconfig/simdjson*
          else: lib/pkgconfig/simdjson*
        - if: win
          then: Library/lib/cmake/simdjson/simdjsonTargets*
          else: lib/cmake/simdjson/simdjsonTargets*
        - if: win
          then: Library/lib/cmake/simdjson/simdjson-config*
          else: lib/cmake/simdjson/simdjson-config*
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('simdjson', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - simdjson.h
          lib:
            - simdjson
          files:
            exists:
              - if: win
                then: Library/lib/cmake/simdjson/simdjson-config.cmake
                else: lib/cmake/simdjson/simdjson-config.cmake
      - if: not (linux and riscv64)
        then:
          files:
            recipe:
              - test/*
          requirements:
            run:
              - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
              - cmake
              - ninja
          script:
            - if: unix
              then: cmake -G Ninja -S test/ -B build/ -D TEST_TARGET=simdjson ${CMAKE_ARGS}
            - if: win
              then: cmake -G Ninja -S test/ -B build/ -D TEST_TARGET=simdjson %CMAKE_ARGS%
            - cmake --build build/
            - cmake --build build --target test
  - package:
      name: simdjson-static
    build:
      script: build
      files:
        - if: unix
          then: lib/libsimdjson_static.a
        - if: win
          then: Library/lib/simdjson_static.lib
        - if: win
          then: Library/lib/cmake/simdjson/simdjson_staticTargets*
          else: lib/cmake/simdjson/simdjson_staticTargets*
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('simdjson', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          files:
            exists:
              - if: unix
                then: lib/libsimdjson_static.a
              - if: win
                then: Library/lib/simdjson_static.lib
      - if: not (linux and riscv64)
        then:
          files:
            recipe:
              - test/*
          requirements:
            run:
              - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
              - cmake
              - ninja
          script:
            - if: unix
              then: cmake -G Ninja -S test/ -B build/ -D TEST_TARGET=simdjson_static ${CMAKE_ARGS}
            - if: win
              then: cmake -G Ninja -S test/ -B build/ -D TEST_TARGET=simdjson_static %CMAKE_ARGS%
            - cmake --build build/
            - cmake --build build --target test
